headline: ByteDance Founder Zhang Yiming Tops China Rich List with $99.7B
summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming has reclaimed the title of China’s richest person with a fortune reaching $99.7 billion, driven by surging wealth among technology entrepreneurs amid an artificial intelligence boom.
why: ByteDance is one of the world's most valuable private technology companies, operating popular platforms like TikTok and Douyin. Its valuation heavily influences global technology and venture capital sentiment.
